papers.title: Hepatitis B Virus Reactivation During FOLFIRINOX Chemotherapy and Granulocyte Colony-Stimulating Factor in Advanced Pancreatic Cancer Case Report
papers.abstract: Abstract Hepatitis B reactivation is a well-recognized complication of immunosuppressive therapy, most commonly reported in patients with hematologic malignancies receiving potent regimens. In contrast, reports of reactivation occur less commonly in solid malignancies, especially pancreatic cancer. Data are limited regarding the potential impact of multidrug therapies, such as FOLFIRINOX. Granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (G-CSF) is frequently used adjunctively, but its role in HBV reactivation is unknown. We report a case of hepatitis B reactivation in a patient with advanced pancreatic cancer with metastasis to the liver receiving modified FOLFIRINOX and pegfilgrastim. The patient presented on June 2, 2025, with fatigue, weakness, peripheral edema, and leukocytosis after cycle 2 of modified FOLFIRINOX on May 21 and pegfilgrastim on May 23. FOLFIRINOX was held during admission because of poor tolerance. Liver enzymes rose during hospitalization, and hepatitis testing demonstrated reactive HBsAg and total anti-HBc, nonreactive anti-HBc IgM, anti-HBs <5 mIU/mL, and HBV DNA 3,760,000 IU/mL (log 6.58). Review of prior records demonstrated HBsAg positivity and negative anti-HBc IgM before chemotherapy, but baseline HBV DNA was not obtained and antiviral prophylaxis was not documented. He was discharged on June 7 and was subsequently started on entecavir 0.5 mg daily by outpatient oncology on June 18. Current guidelines recommend HBV screening before systemic anticancer therapy and antiviral prophylaxis for HBsAg-positive patients receiving systemic therapy. Thus, this case highlights the importance of implementing existing recommendations for complete HBV screening, baseline HBV DNA assessment, and antiviral prophylaxis in patients with solid tumors receiving chemotherapy.

papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 在 FOLFIRINOX 化疗和粒细胞集落刺激因子治疗晚期胰腺癌中的再激活 病例报告
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Hepatitis B reactivation is a well-recognized complication of immunosuppressive therapy, most commonly reported in patients with hematologic malignancies receiving potent regimens. In contrast, reports of reactivation occur less commonly in solid malignancies, especially pancreatic cancer. Data are limited regarding the potential impact of multidrug therapies, such as FOLFIRINOX. Granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (G-CSF) is frequently used adjunctively, but its role in HBV reactivation is unknown. We report a case of hepatitis B reactivation in a patient with advanced pancreatic cancer with metastasis to the liver receiving modified FOLFIRINOX and pegfilgrastim. The patient presented on June 2, 2025, with fatigue, weakness, peripheral edema, and leukocytosis after cycle 2 of modified FOLFIRINOX on May 21 and pegfilgrastim on May 23. FOLFIRINOX was held during admission because of poor tolerance. Liver enzymes rose during hospitalization, and hepatitis testing demonstrated reactive HBsAg and total anti-HBc, nonreactive anti-HBc IgM, anti-HBs <5 mIU/mL, and HBV DNA 3,760,000 IU/mL (log 6.58). Review of prior records demonstrated HBsAg positivity and negative anti-HBc IgM before chemotherapy, but baseline HBV DNA was not obtained and antiviral prophylaxis was not documented. He was discharged on June 7 and was subsequently started on entecavir 0.5 mg daily by outpatient oncology on June 18. Current guidelines recommend HBV screening before systemic anticancer therapy and antiviral prophylaxis for HBsAg-positive patients receiving systemic therapy. Thus, this case highlights the importance of implementing existing recommendations for complete HBV screening, baseline HBV DNA assessment, and antiviral prophylaxis in patients with solid tumors receiving chemotherapy.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 乙型肝炎病毒再激活是免疫抑制治疗中一个众所周知的并发症,最常报告于接受强效方案治疗的血液系统恶性肿瘤患者中。相比之下,实体瘤患者中报告的乙型肝炎病毒再激活较少,尤其是胰腺癌患者。关于多药联合治疗(如 FOLFIRINOX)对乙型肝炎病毒再激活的潜在影响的数据有限。粒细胞集落刺激因子(G-CSF)常作为辅助治疗使用,但其在乙型肝炎病毒再激活中的作用尚不清楚。我们报告了一例晚期胰腺癌合并肝转移患者在接受改良 FOLFIRINOX 和聚乙二醇化重组人粒细胞集落刺激因子治疗后发生乙型肝炎病毒再激活的病例。该患者于 2025 年 6 月 2 日出现疲劳、虚弱、周围水肿和白细胞增多,这是在 5 月 21 日接受改良 FOLFIRINOX 治疗和 5 月 23 日接受聚乙二醇化重组人粒细胞集落刺激因子治疗后的第 2 个周期。由于患者耐受性差,住院期间暂停了 FOLFIRINOX 治疗。住院期间肝酶升高,乙型肝炎检测显示反应性 HBsAg 和总抗-HBc,非反应性抗-HBc IgM,抗-HBs <5 mIU/mL,以及 HBV DNA 3,760,000 IU/mL(log 6.58)。回顾既往记录显示,在化疗前 HBsAg 阳性,但抗-HBc IgM 阴性,且未获得基线 HBV DNA 检测结果,也未记录 抗病毒药物 预防措施。该患者于 6 月 7 日出院,并于 6 月 18 日由门诊肿瘤科开始每日服用恩替卡韦 0.5 mg。目前指南建议在系统性抗癌治疗前进行 HBV 筛查,并对 HBsAg 阳性患者进行 抗病毒药物 预防。因此,该病例强调了在接受化疗的实体瘤患者中实施现有推荐进行完整 HBV 筛查、基线 HBV DNA 评估和 抗病毒药物 预防措施的重要性。

papers.title: Realizing personalized prediction for the reversal of chronic hepatitis B-associated liver fibrosis through machine learning
papers.abstract: Although long-term antiviral therapy can reverse liver fibrosis in a considerable proportion of patients with chronic hepatitis B, treatment response differs markedly among individuals, and reliable methods for predicting who will benefit remain lacking. Conventional clinical tools such as liver stiffness measurement and the aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ratio index were originally dewsigned for cross-sectional staging rather than longitudinal prediction, and their ability to capture the dynamic process of fibrosis reversal is limited. In this opinion review, we discuss how machine learning (ML) may help address this unmet need. We focus on three areas where ML has shown early but encouraging results: Quantitative analysis of images using ML, integration of pathological and clinical data through multimodal models, and dynamic prediction of treatment response based on serial measurements during antiviral therapy. In our view, the greatest value of ML lies not in replacing existing assessment tools but in complementing them, particularly through the early identification of patients who are unlikely to achieve fibrosis reversal with antiviral therapy alone. However, we also caution that most current models have been developed from small, single-center retrospective cohorts, and their clinical adoption will require prospective multi-center validation, improved model interpretability, and adherence to standardized reporting frameworks.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential of machine learning to improve the prediction of liver fibrosis reversal in chronic hepatitis B patients. It highlights the limitations of conventional clinical tools in capturing dynamic fibrosis processes and emphasizes the need for more robust models. The authors argue that machine learning can complement existing methods by identifying patients who may not benefit from antiviral therapy alone. While the study is an opinion review, it suggests that integrating clinical and pathological data through machine learning could enhance surveillance and treatment strategies. The evidence is based on existing models, which are limited by their derivation from small, single-center cohorts. The findings indicate that machine learning may offer new insights into personalized prediction but require further validation for broader clinical application.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决目前缺乏可靠方法预测慢性乙型肝炎患者对治疗反应的问题,因为长期抗病毒治疗可以逆转肝纤维化,但并非所有患者都能实现逆转。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本观点综述讨论了机器学习在改善慢性乙型肝炎患者纤维化逆转预测方面的潜力,重点关注临床工具在捕捉动态纤维化过程方面的局限性。
elements_zh.methods: 作者回顾了机器学习如何应用于分析影像数据、整合临床和病理数据,并通过在抗病毒治疗期间进行连续测量来预测患者对治疗的反应。
elements_zh.main_results: 机器学习在三个领域已显示出早期但有希望的结果:定量影像分析、临床和病理数据的多模态整合,以及基于连续测量的动态预测患者对治疗的反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释认为,机器学习的最大价值在于补充现有工具,特别是在识别那些仅通过抗病毒药物治疗难以实现纤维化逆转的患者方面,而不是取代它们。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,机器学习可能有助于提高慢性乙型肝炎治疗的功能性治愈率,并优化个性化治疗策略,从而改善纤维化逆转的预测能力并指导临床决策。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 目前的证据受到限制,因为大多数现有模型都是基于小规模、单一中心的回顾性数据,这可能影响其普适性,需要前瞻性多中心验证。

papers.abstract_zh: 尽管长期抗病毒药物治疗可以逆转慢性乙型肝炎患者的肝纤维化,但个体对治疗的反应差异显著,目前仍缺乏可靠的预测方法。传统的临床工具如肝硬度测量和天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶与血小板比值指数最初设计用于横断面分期,而非纵向预测,其捕捉纤维化逆转动态过程的能力有限。在本观点综述中,我们讨论了机器学习(ML)如何帮助解决这一未满足的需求。我们重点关注了机器学习在三个方面的早期但有希望的结果:利用机器学习进行图像的定量分析、通过多模态模型整合病理和临床数据,以及基于抗病毒药物治疗期间的连续测量动态预测治疗反应。我们认为,机器学习的最大价值并不在于取代现有评估工具,而在于补充它们,特别是在早期识别那些仅通过抗病毒药物治疗难以实现纤维化逆转的患者方面。然而,我们也提醒,目前大多数模型都是基于小规模、单中心的回顾性队列研究开发的,其临床应用需要前瞻性多中心验证、提高模型的可解释性以及遵循标准化的报告框架。

papers.title: Longitudinal hematologic decline during peginterferon alfa-2b therapy in chronic hepatitis B: clinical safety and exploratory whole-blood transcriptomics
papers.abstract: Peginterferon-based therapy for chronic hepatitis B is known to cause leukopenia, neutropenia, and thrombocytopenia, but the relationship of early hematologic trajectories to serological response, supportive management, and whole-blood molecular signals remains uncertain. We conducted an exploratory hematologic safety-focused secondary analysis of a prospective, single-center cohort of 21 patients receiving peginterferon alfa-2b-based therapy (13 responders and 8 non-responders). WBC, ANC, and platelet counts were assessed at visits corresponding approximately to baseline, Week 5, and Week 10. Non-parametric comparisons were supplemented with effect sizes and 95% confidence intervals, and supportive-treatment timing was examined in locked sensitivity analyses. All paired Visit-1-to-Visit-3 changes were negative in both response groups, whereas responder-versus-non-responder estimates were imprecise and did not establish a response-group-specific toxicity pattern. Visit-2 WBC <4.0 × 10 9 /L occurred in 19/21 patients (90.5%; exact 95% CI: 69.6%-98.8%) and was treated as a pragmatic clinical-management context threshold rather than a discriminating transcriptomic endpoint. A post-documented oral-support-date indicator did not materially alter the fitted WBC or ANC pattern, but this non-randomized sensitivity analysis cannot estimate treatment efficacy. In the manuscript-consistent DESeq2 variance-stabilizing-transformation workflow, no unadjusted primary Hallmark or candidate-gene family met the prespecified exploratory BH-FDR q < 0.10 threshold. A reviewer-directed xCell2 sensitivity analysis showed longitudinal internal concordance between the prespecified neutrophil enrichment score and measured ANC; composition adjustment changed several pathway estimates, but no paired W0-W10 family reached q < 0.10 and unstable baseline-adjusted platelet signals did not support a specific pathway or mechanism. These small-cohort findings are exploratory, are not evidence of equivalence or mechanism, and require confirmation in larger independent cohorts.

analysis.summary_en: This review article examines the hematologic safety of peginterferon alfa-2b therapy in chronic hepatitis B patients, focusing on longitudinal changes in white blood cell (WBC), absolute neutrophil count (ANC), and platelet counts. The study is a secondary analysis of a single-center cohort of 21 patients, with 13 responders and 8 non-responders. While all paired Visit-1-to-Visit-3 changes were negative in both groups, the responder-versus-non-responder estimates were imprecise and did not reveal a specific toxicity pattern. The manuscript-consistent DESeq2 workflow did not identify any unadjusted primary Hallmark or candidate-gene family meeting the BH-FDR q < 0.10 threshold. A reviewer-directed xCell2 sensitivity analysis showed internal concordance between the prespecified neutrophil enrichment score and measured ANC, but no paired W0-W10 family reached q < 0.10. The study highlights the need for larger independent cohorts to confirm these findings and better understand the molecular mechanisms underlying hematologic changes during therapy.

papers.title_zh: peginterferon alfa-2b治疗慢性乙型肝炎期间的血细胞纵向下降:临床安全性及探索性全血转录组学分析
papers.source_body_en: Peginterferon-based therapy for chronic hepatitis B is known to cause leukopenia, neutropenia, and thrombocytopenia, but the relationship of early hematologic trajectories to serological response, supportive management, and whole-blood molecular signals remains uncertain. We conducted an exploratory hematologic safety-focused secondary analysis of a prospective, single-center cohort of 21 patients receiving peginterferon alfa-2b-based therapy (13 responders and 8 non-responders). WBC, ANC, and platelet counts were assessed at visits corresponding approximately to baseline, Week 5, and Week 10. Non-parametric comparisons were supplemented with effect sizes and 95% confidence intervals, and supportive-treatment timing was examined in locked sensitivity analyses. All paired Visit-1-to-Visit-3 changes were negative in both response groups, whereas responder-versus-non-responder estimates were imprecise and did not establish a response-group-specific toxicity pattern. Visit-2 WBC <4.0 × 10 9 /L occurred in 19/21 patients (90.5%; exact 95% CI: 69.6%-98.8%) and was treated as a pragmatic clinical-management context threshold rather than a discriminating transcriptomic endpoint. A post-documented oral-support-date indicator did not materially alter the fitted WBC or ANC pattern, but this non-randomized sensitivity analysis cannot estimate treatment efficacy. In the manuscript-consistent DESeq2 variance-stabilizing-transformation workflow, no unadjusted primary Hallmark or candidate-gene family met the prespecified exploratory BH-FDR q < 0.10 threshold. A reviewer-directed xCell2 sensitivity analysis showed longitudinal internal concordance between the prespecified neutrophil enrichment score and measured ANC; composition adjustment changed several pathway estimates, but no paired W0-W10 family reached q < 0.10 and unstable baseline-adjusted platelet signals did not support a specific pathway or mechanism. These small-cohort findings are exploratory, are not evidence of equivalence or mechanism, and require confirmation in larger independent cohorts.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于peginterferon的慢性乙型肝炎治疗已知会导致白细胞减少、中性粒细胞减少和血小板减少,但早期血细胞轨迹与血清学反应、支持性管理及全血分子信号之间的关系仍不确定。我们对一项前瞻性、单中心的21例接受peginterferon alfa-2b治疗的队列研究进行了探索性血细胞安全性为中心的二次分析(13例应答者和8例非应答者)。在大致对应基线、第5周和第10周的访视中评估了白细胞计数(WBC)、中性粒细胞绝对值(ANC)和血小板计数。非参数比较补充了效应量和95%置信区间,并在锁定敏感性分析中探讨了支持性-治疗的时间。所有配对的第1次访视至第3次访视的变化在两个应答组中均为负值,而应答者与非应答者之间的估计值不够精确,未能建立特定应答组的毒性模式。第2次访视时WBC <4.0 × 10 9 /L发生在19/21例患者(90.5%;精确95%置信区间:69.6%-98.8%),被用作一种实用的临床管理阈值,而非区分性的转录组学终点。一个在口服支持日期后记录的指标并未显著改变拟合的WBC或ANC模式,但这种非随机化的敏感性分析无法估计治疗的疗效。在与手稿一致的DESeq2方差稳定变换工作流程中,未调整的主要Hallmark或候选基因家族均未达到预设的探索性BH-FDR q < 0.10阈值。由审稿人指导的xCell2敏感性分析显示,预设的中性粒细胞富集评分与测量的ANC之间存在纵向内部一致性;成分调整改变了若干通路估计值,但没有任何配对的W0-W10家族达到q < 0.10,且不稳定的基础调整血小板信号未支持特定的通路或机制。这些小型队列研究的发现是探索性的,不能作为等效性或机制的证据,需要在更大的独立队列研究中进行确认。

papers.title: Single-molecule and long-read sequencing reveals structural diversity of hepatitis B virus haplotypes including mutations, deletions, and splicing.
papers.abstract: AIM: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) exhibits diverse pathological states during chronic infection. While defective genomes with deletions and splicing have been sporadically reported, the quasispecies structure and their role in disease progression have remained unclear due to technical constraints of conventional short-read sequencing. METHODS: Using rolling circle amplification (RCA)-nanopore long-read sequencing, we analyzed near full-length HBV genomes (approximately 3.2kb) at the single-molecule level from 6 serum samples obtained from 5 patients. Haplotypes were reconstructed from reads with point mutations, and structural linkages with deletions and splicing were evaluated. RESULTS: Diverse haplotypes (three to five per patient) involving mutations across the HBV genome, predominantly in putative immune-targeted regions (core, preS, and surface), were detected in all cases, along with variants containing different deletions and splicing patterns. Notably, in chronic hepatitis and hepatocellular carcinoma cases, a substantial portion (29.5-71.3%) of circulating HBV DNA consisted of deletion and splicing variants, which clustered significantly in specific haplotypes (p < 2.8 × 10−5). Longitudinal changes in haplotype composition involving point mutations and different deletion/splicing patterns were observed in one patient before and after HBeAg seroconversion. CONCLUSIONS: HBV exists as a population comprising multiple haplotypes with mutations, deletions, and splicing interconnected and dynamically changing according to disease state. Monitoring circulating splicing variants and haplotype dynamics may serve as novel biomarkers for disease understanding. This single-molecule long-read analysis elucidates the molecular basis of HBV quasispecies evolution.

analysis.summary_en: This study used single-molecule and long-read sequencing to investigate the structural diversity of hepatitis B virus (HBV) haplotypes, including mutations, deletions, and splicing, in patients with chronic hepatitis and hepatocellular carcinoma. The analysis revealed that diverse haplotypes, particularly in immune-targeted regions, were present in all cases, with a substantial proportion of circulating HBV DNA consisting of deletion and splicing variants. These variants clustered in specific haplotypes, and longitudinal changes in haplotype composition were observed in one patient. The authors concluded that HBV exists as a population of interconnected haplotypes that dynamically change with disease state, offering new insights into quasispecies evolution. The findings suggest potential applications in disease monitoring and understanding, though the study's small sample size limits generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)在慢性感染期间表现出多样的病理状态。本研究旨在探讨HBV谱系的结构多样性,包括突变、缺失和剪接,以更好地理解其在疾病进展中的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用滚环扩增(RCA)-纳米孔长读长测序技术,分析来自5名患者的6份血清样本中近完整的HBV 基因组。分析聚焦于HBV谱系及其在慢性肝炎和肝细胞癌背景下的结构变异。
elements_zh.methods: 使用RCA-纳米孔长读长测序技术对近完整的HBV 基因组进行单分子水平分析。通过读取中包含点突变的突变重建了谱系,并评估了缺失和剪接的结构关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有病例中均检测到涉及突变的多样化谱系(每位患者3至5种),主要位于HBV 基因组的免疫靶向区域,同时还观察到具有不同缺失和剪接模式的变异体。在慢性肝炎和肝细胞癌病例中,循环HBV DNA的相当大一部分(29.5-71.3%)由缺失和剪接变异体组成,这些变异体在特定谱系中显著聚集(p < 2.8 × 10−5)。在一名患者HBeAg血清转换前后,观察到涉及点突变突变和不同缺失/剪接模式的谱系组成纵向变化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为HBV以包含突变、缺失和剪接的多种谱系群体存在,这些谱系根据疾病状态动态变化。本研究为HBV准种进化的分子基础提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,监测循环剪接变异体和谱系动态可能作为理解疾病的新生物标志物。这可能为未来关于HBV 监测、诊断和治疗策略的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于5名患者和6份血清样本,这可能限制其普遍适用性。然而,由于采用了单分子长读长测序技术,能够详细分析HBV的结构多样性,因此证据较强。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,监测循环剪接变异体和谱系动态可能作为理解疾病的新生物标志物。这可能为未来关于HBV 监测、诊断和治疗策略的研究提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于5名患者和6份血清样本,这可能限制其普遍适用性。然而,由于采用了单分子长读长测序技术,能够详细分析HBV的结构多样性,因此证据较强。

papers.title: Hepatic Steatosis in People With Chronic Hepatitis B in Africa: Prevalence, Correlates, and Clinical Significance.
papers.abstract: To address data gaps around metabolic liver disease in Africa, within the Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET), we evaluated participants with chronic hepatitis B virus infection (CHB) for steatotic liver disease (SLD) using transient elastography with controlled attenuation parameter (CAP). Using multivariable logistic regression, we identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical associations with SLD (CAP ≥ 248 dB/m), and evaluated whether SLD severity was independently associated with fibrosis. Short-term impacts of SLD on mortality were also assessed with Cox proportional hazards analysis. We also evaluated the diagnostic performance of B-mode ultrasound for SLD, with CAP as reference. Across 6 countries and 1601 participants (age range, 12-80 years; 39.5% female; 4% with diabetes; 11% unhealthy alcohol use; median body mass index, 24.4), 421 (26.3%) had SLD; 219 (13.7%) had severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). Older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status were associated with SLD. After adjusting for age, sex, HIV status, HBV treatment, and country, severe steatosis, but not mild and moderate forms (i.e., 248-279 dB/m), was associated with a 8.4% (95%, 1.9%-14.9%) increased probability of fibrosis. Over limited follow-up (median 2.69 years) and small number of deaths, SLD was not associated with all-cause or liver-related mortality. B-mode ultrasound had low sensitivity for SLD, overall or when severe, but specificity was 95%. In conclusion, SLD was common in people with CHB in Africa and its severe form was associated with liver fibrosis. These data support screening for metabolic comorbidities as part of HBV care and treatment in Africa.
authors: Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET)

papers.abstract_zh: 为了解决非洲地区代谢性肝病的数据缺口,我们在非洲乙型肝炎合作网络(HEPSANET)中评估了慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者是否患有脂肪性肝病(SLD),使用了瞬时弹性成像结合控制衰减参数(CAP)。通过多变量逻辑回归分析,我们确定了与SLD(CAP ≥ 248 dB/m)相关的社会人口学、人体测量学和临床特征,并评估了SLD严重程度是否独立与纤维化相关。我们还使用Cox比例风险模型评估了SLD对死亡率的短期影响。此外,我们评估了B型超声波在SLD诊断中的表现,以CAP为参考标准。在6个国家的1601名参与者(年龄范围12-80岁;39.5%女性;4%患有糖尿病;11%有不健康饮酒行为;中位数体重指数24.4)中,421名(26.3%)患有SLD;219名(13.7%)患有严重脂肪变(CAP ≥ 280 dB/m)。年龄较大、男性性别、超重和肥胖以及HIV阴性状态与SLD相关。在调整年龄、性别、HIV状态、HBV 治疗和国家后,严重脂肪变(而非轻度和中度形式,即248-279 dB/m)与纤维化概率增加8.4%(95%置信区间1.9%-14.9%)相关。在有限的随访时间(中位数2.69年)和较少的死亡病例下,SLD与全因或肝相关死亡率无显著关联。B型超声波对SLD的敏感性较低,无论是整体还是在严重情况下,但特异性为95%。总之,SLD在非洲CHB患者中较为常见,其严重形式与肝纤维化相关。这些数据支持在非洲HBV管理中纳入代谢性共病的筛查措施以及治疗的监测。

papers.title: Becoming Physically Active and Risks of Mortality and Liver-Related Events in Adults With Chronic Hepatitis B: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Physical activity (PA) confers several health benefits; however, whether increasing PA among physically inactive adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) is associated with lower risks of adverse clinical outcomes remains unclear. We used the nationwide Korean National Health Insurance database. We included 318,131 adults with CHB who were physically inactive at the initial health screening (Exam 1) and completed a subsequent screening within 4 years (Exam 2). Among them, 58,703 initiated moderate-to-vigorous PA (MVPA), defined as vigorous activity ≥ 20 min/day on ≥ 3 days/week or moderate activity ≥ 30 min/day on ≥ 5 days/week. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality, and the secondary outcomes were liver-related events (hepatic decompensation, liver transplantation, hepatocellular carcinoma [HCC]) and HCC. Multivariable Cox and Fine-Grey competing-risk models were adjusted for demographic, clinical, and behavioural factors. During a median 7.9-year follow-up (IQR, 5.2-9.5), 7609 deaths occurred. MVPA initiation was associated with lower all-cause mortality (hazard ratio [HR], 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), a lower risk of liver-related events (subdistribution HR [subHR], 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and, more modestly, of HCC (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared with those remaining inactive. The association was more pronounced in older adults, women, never smokers, non-drinkers, and untreated participants (all p for interaction ≤ 0.03). Initiating MVPA among physically inactive adults with CHB was associated with lower risks of mortality and liver-related outcomes. These findings provide large-scale epidemiological evidence supporting further evaluation of PA promotion in physically inactive patients with CHB.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the association between initiating moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) and reduced risks of mortality and liver-related events in adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Using the nationwide Korean National Health Insurance database, the researchers followed 318,131 physically inactive adults with CHB over a median of 7.9 years. They found that MVPA initiation was linked to lower all-cause mortality (HR, 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), reduced liver-related events (subHR, 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and a modest decrease in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared to those who remained inactive. The associations were stronger in specific subgroups, including older adults, women, and untreated participants. The study highlights the potential public health significance of promoting physical activity in CHB patients, though it does not provide direct causal evidence.

papers.title: Superiority of magnetic resonance elastography and proton density fat fraction: an umbrella meta-analysis of non-invasive imaging for hepatic steatosis and fibrosis in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Background: Various quantitative techniques based on ultrasound (US) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) have been widely used to assess hepatic steatosis and fibrosis. This study thus aimed to synthesize and critically evaluate the evidence derived from systematic reviews on the diagnostic performance of noninvasive imaging techniques including transient elastography (TE), point shear wave elastography (pSWE), two-dimensional shear wave elastography (2D-SWE), magnetic resonance elastography (MRE), controlled attenuation parameter (CAP), and proton density fat fraction (PDFF) for liver fibrosis and steatosis in patients with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Methods: Searches were performed on PubMed, Embase, the Web of Science, and Cochrane Library from database inception until 2 March 2025, including keywords ‘liver diseases’, imaging’, ‘systematic review’ and others. We included systematic reviews that comprised studies evaluating the diagnostic performance of non-invasive imaging techniques for liver fibrosis or steatosis in patients with MASLD or CHB. Results: Thirty-six systematic reviews were included from 3,752 articles. For hepatic steatosis assessment, PDFF demonstrated high diagnostic stability, while CAP showed good screening performance for mild steatosis. For liver fibrosis assessment, MRE exhibited high diagnostic accuracy for significant (≥F2), advanced (≥F3) fibrosis, and cirrhosis (F4). In obese MASLD patients, MRE demonstrated superior specificity compared to TE. Among CHB patients, MRE displayed particularly high diagnostic performance. Other techniques (2D-SWE, TE) remained clinically valuable in specific stages and patient populations. Conclusions: MRE performance varied between the two etiologies, suggesting liver stiffness is a composite biomarker. PDFF provides precise quantification of steatosis, while CAP is suitable for screening mild cases. The findings emphasize the necessity of developing personalized imaging strategies based on etiology to optimize patient management and reduce reliance on liver biopsy.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:基于超声(US)和磁共振成像(MRI)的各种定量技术已被广泛用于评估肝脂肪变和纤维化。本研究旨在综合并批判性地评估系统综述中关于非侵入性影像学技术(包括瞬时弹性成像(TE)、点剪切波弹性成像(pSWE)、二维剪切波弹性成像(2D-SWE)、磁共振弹性成像(MRE)、控制衰减参数(CAP)和质子密度脂肪分数(PDFF))在代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病(MASLD)和慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者中对肝纤维化和脂肪变的诊断性能的证据。方法:从数据库建立开始,直至2025年3月2日,在PubMed、Embase、Web of Science和Cochrane Library上进行了检索,包括关键词‘肝病’、‘影像学’、‘系统综述’等。我们纳入了评估非侵入性影像学技术在MASLD或CHB患者中对肝纤维化或脂肪变诊断性能的系统综述。结果:从3752篇文章中纳入了36篇系统综述。对于肝脂肪变的评估,PDFF表现出高诊断稳定性,而CAP在轻度脂肪变的筛查中表现出良好的性能。对于肝纤维化的评估,MRE在显著(≥F2)、进展性(≥F3)纤维化和肝硬化(F4)中显示出高诊断准确性。在肥胖的MASLD患者中,MRE的特异性优于TE。在CHB患者中,MRE表现出特别高的诊断性能。其他技术(2D-SWE、TE)在特定阶段和患者群体中仍具有临床价值。结论:MRE在两种病因中的表现存在差异,表明肝硬度是一个复合生物标志物。PDFF提供了脂肪变的精确量化,而CAP适用于筛查轻度病例。研究结果强调了根据病因制定个性化影像学策略的必要性,以优化患者管理并减少对肝活检的依赖。

papers.title: Small molecules inhibit hepatitis B and D virus infection by binding the small surface antigen.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Current therapies for chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection effectively suppress viral replication but do not achieve a functional cure. Targeting viral entry represents a promising strategy to complement existing treatments. METHODS: Small-molecule compounds were identified through structure-based virtual screening targeting SHBs (small hepatitis B surface antigen). HBV infection models using HepG2-NTCP cells and primary human hepatocytes were established to investigate the antiviral activities and underlying mechanisms of these compounds in vitro. Molecular docking analyses were performed to predict the potential binding regions of the small molecules with SHBs. In addition, we performed mutagenesis based on the predicted interaction residues, followed by functional assays to validate the docking predictions. RESULTS: Assays in the HBV infection model showed that isotretinoin, ciprofibrate, and caffeic acid significantly reduced HBsAg, HBeAg, and HBV pregenomic RNA levels when administered concurrently with HBV infection. Biophysical and biochemical assays demonstrated that these compounds interacted with SHBs. In addition, molecular docking and site-directed mutagenesis-based functional assays suggested that the interaction sites may involve the AGL region. Mechanistically, the compounds mainly acted during the early stage of infection and reduced HBV attachment and internalization-associated signals. In addition, these compounds inhibited HDV infection, supporting their activity against HBV envelope-mediated viral entry. CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that these small molecules are promising candidates for developing novel entry inhibitors targeting SHBs, which may enhance therapeutic options against HBV and HDV.

papers.title_zh: 小分子通过结合小表面抗原抑制乙型肝炎病毒和丁型肝炎病毒感染。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Current therapies for chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection effectively suppress viral replication but do not achieve a functional cure. Targeting viral entry represents a promising strategy to complement existing treatments. METHODS: Small-molecule compounds were identified through structure-based virtual screening targeting SHBs (small hepatitis B surface antigen). HBV infection models using HepG2-NTCP cells and primary human hepatocytes were established to investigate the antiviral activities and underlying mechanisms of these compounds in vitro. Molecular docking analyses were performed to predict the potential binding regions of the small molecules with SHBs. In addition, we performed mutagenesis based on the predicted interaction residues, followed by functional assays to validate the docking predictions. RESULTS: Assays in the HBV infection model showed that isotretinoin, ciprofibrate, and caffeic acid significantly reduced HBsAg, HBeAg, and HBV pregenomic RNA levels when administered concurrently with HBV infection. Biophysical and biochemical assays demonstrated that these compounds interacted with SHBs. In addition, molecular docking and site-directed mutagenesis-based functional assays suggested that the interaction sites may involve the AGL region. Mechanistically, the compounds mainly acted during the early stage of infection and reduced HBV attachment and internalization-associated signals. In addition, these compounds inhibited HDV infection, supporting their activity against HBV envelope-mediated viral entry. CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that these small molecules are promising candidates for developing novel entry inhibitors targeting SHBs, which may enhance therapeutic options against HBV and HDV.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景与目的:目前针对乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染的治疗方法能够有效抑制病毒复制,但无法实现功能性治愈。针对病毒入侵过程是补充现有治疗策略的有前景方法。方法:通过基于结构的虚拟筛选技术,识别出针对小乙肝表面抗原(SHBs)的小分子化合物。利用HepG2-NTCP细胞和原代人肝细胞建立HBV感染模型,以研究这些化合物在体外对SHBs的活性及其潜在机制。进行了分子对接分析,以预测小分子与SHBs的潜在结合区域。此外,基于预测的相互作用残基进行了诱变实验,并通过功能实验验证对接预测。结果:在HBV感染模型中,异维A酸、吉非罗齐和咖啡酸在与HBV感染同时给药时,显著降低了HBsAg、HBeAg和HBV前基因组RNA的水平。生物物理和生化实验表明这些化合物与SHBs相互作用。此外,分子对接和基于定点诱变的功能实验提示,这些化合物的结合位点可能涉及AGL区域。机制上,这些化合物主要在感染早期起作用,减少了与HBV附着和内化相关的信号。此外,这些化合物还抑制了HDV感染,支持其对HBV包膜介导的病毒入侵的抑制作用。结论:我们的研究结果表明,这些小分子可能是开发针对SHBs的新入侵抑制剂的有前景候选物,这可能增强针对HBV和HDV的治疗选择。

papers.title: Renal Safety and Antiviral Effectiveness of Tenofovir Alafenamide Versus Entecavir in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis B and Chronic Kidney Disease: A Real-World Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Real-world data on tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), especially in patients with advanced renal impairment, are scarce. We evaluated its renal safety and antiviral effectiveness versus entecavir (ETV) in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and pre-existing chronic kidney disease (CKD). In this retrospective single-centre study, CHB patients with pre-existing CKD treated with TAF or ETV were included. The primary outcome was change in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) over 48 weeks. Secondary outcomes included virological, biochemical and metabolic responses. Exploratory subgroup analyses were performed by CKD stage and dialysis status. Among 54 patients (35 TAF, 19 ETV), renal function remained stable in both groups. eGFR change from baseline to week 48 was not significantly different between the TAF and ETV groups (1.56 ± 8.14 vs. -0.53 ± 9.78 mL/min/1.73 m2; Δchange, 2.09; 95% CI, -0.35 to 7.68; p = 0.46). Both groups achieved sustained viral suppression, with no significant difference in undetectable HBV DNA in week-48. HBsAg reduction was greater with TAF than with ETV (-0.36 ± 0.42 vs. 0.02 ± 0.34 log10 IU/mL; p = 0.01). Exploratory analyses in patients with eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, TAF showed effective viral suppression and renal safety regardless of dialysis status. Metabolic parameters remained stable, without complex dose adjustments. TAF was safe and effective in CHB patients with CKD, including those with advanced renal impairment. Its renal safety and antiviral effectiveness did not differ significantly from those of ETV, with the practical advantage of fixed dosing without complex adjustment.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to evaluate the renal safety and antiviral effectiveness of tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) compared to entecavir (ETV) in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and pre-existing chronic kidney disease (CKD). A retrospective single-centre cohort study was conducted, including 54 patients (35 on TAF and 19 on ETV). The primary outcome was the change in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) over 48 weeks, while secondary outcomes included virological, biochemical, and metabolic responses. The results showed that renal function remained stable in both groups, with no significant difference in eGFR change between TAF and ETV. Both groups achieved sustained viral suppression, with no significant difference in undetectable HBV DNA at week 48. However, HBsAg reduction was greater with TAF than with ETV. Exploratory subgroup analyses indicated that TAF was effective and safe in patients with advanced renal impairment. The study highlights the potential of TAF as a treatment option for CHB patients with CKD, offering the advantage of fixed dosing without complex adjustments. The evidence is limited by the study's retrospective design and small sample size, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

papers.abstract_zh: 关于替诺福韦艾拉酚胺(TAF)的现实世界数据,尤其是在肾功能严重受损的患者中,仍然非常有限。我们评估了TAF与恩替卡韦(ETV)在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)合并已有慢性肾脏病(CKD)患者中的肾脏安全性及有效性。本研究为一项回顾性单中心研究,纳入了接受TAF或ETV治疗的CHB合并已有CKD的患者。主要结局是48周内估算肾小球滤过率(eGFR)的变化。次要结局包括病毒学、生化和代谢反应。通过CKD阶段和透析状态进行了探索性亚组分析。在54名患者(35名接受TAF治疗,19名接受ETV治疗)中,两个组的肾功能均保持稳定。从基线到第48周,TAF组与ETV组的eGFR变化无显著差异(1.56 ± 8.14 vs. -0.53 ± 9.78 mL/min/1.73 m2;变化差值,2.09;95%置信区间,-0.35至7.68;p = 0.46)。两个组均实现了持续病毒抑制,第48周时检测不到HBV DNA无显著差异。TAF组的HBsAg下降幅度大于ETV组(-0.36 ± 0.42 vs. 0.02 ± 0.34 log10 IU/mL;p = 0.01)。在eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2的患者中,无论是否接受透析,TAF均表现出有效的病毒抑制和肾脏安全性。代谢参数保持稳定,无需复杂的剂量调整。TAF在CKD合并CHB患者中是安全且有效的,包括那些肾功能严重受损的患者。其肾脏安全性和有效性与ETV相比无显著差异,且具有固定剂量无需复杂调整的实用性优势。

papers.title: Semi-quantitative ultrasound scoring reveals hepatic structural recovery and immune modulation during tenofovir alafenamide therapy in chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Objective This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic response to tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) using a semi-quantitative ultrasound (US) scoring system, and to investigate the correlation between sonographic changes and immune function restoration. Methods A total of 100 CHB patients who received TAF monotherapy (25 mg/day) for at least 24 months were retrospectively enrolled. A seven-parameter semi-quantitative US score, encompassing liver echogenicity, capsular contour, margin shape, vessel clarity, portal vein diameter (PVD), spleen thickness (ST), and splenic vein velocity (SVV), was calculated at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Concurrently, serum hepatitis B virus (HBV) deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), peripheral T-cell subsets, including cluster of differentiation 3-positive (CD3 + ), CD4 + , CD8 + T cells, CD4+/CD8+ ratio, and natural killer (NK) cell activity were measured. Correlations between US scores and biochemical/immune parameters were analyzed. Results At 24 months, all patients achieved HBV DNA <20 IU/mL, with ALT and AST normalization rates of 92% and 95%, respectively. The comprehensive US score decreased significantly from 7.86 ± 1.73 at baseline to 3.37 ± 0.95 at 24 months ( P < 0.001), with the most pronounced improvements observed in capsular smoothness and parenchymal homogeneity. The CD4 + T-cell proportion and CD4 + /CD8 + ratio increased, whereas the CD8 + proportion decreased; NK cell activity rose from 42.7 ± 7.3% to 52.4 ± 6.2% ( P < 0.05). The US score was positively correlated with ALT (r = 0.56) and AST (r = 0.47), and negatively correlated with the CD4 + /CD8 + ratio (r = −0.46) and NK cell activity (r = −0.38) (all P < 0.01). Conclusion These findings indicate that TAF not only suppresses viral replication and normalises liver enzymes but also promotes measurable structural liver improvement, as reflected by declining semi-quantitative US scores. The strong correlations of US scores with biochemical and immune parameters support its utility as a non-invasive imaging biomarker for monitoring treatment efficacy and hepatic repair.

papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在利用半定量超声(US)评分系统评估替诺福韦艾拉酚胺二甲基磺酸盐(TAF)在慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)患者中的治疗反应,并探讨超声影像变化与免疫功能恢复之间的相关性。方法 入选了100例接受TAF单药治疗(25 mg/天)至少24个月的慢性乙型肝炎患者进行回顾性分析。在基线、12个月和24个月时计算了包含肝脏回声、包膜轮廓、边缘形态、血管清晰度、门静脉直径(PVD)、脾脏厚度(ST)和脾静脉血流速度(SVV)的七参数半定量超声评分。同时测量了血清乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)脱氧核糖核酸(DNA)、丙氨酸氨基转移酶(ALT)、天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶(AST)以及外周T细胞亚群,包括分化簇3阳性(CD3+)、CD4+、CD8+ T细胞、CD4+/CD8+比值和自然杀伤(NK)细胞活性。分析了超声评分与生化和免疫参数之间的相关性。结果 在24个月时,所有患者均达到HBV DNA <20 IU/mL,ALT和AST的正常化率分别为92%和95%。综合超声评分从基线的7.86 ± 1.73显著下降至24个月的3.37 ± 0.95(P < 0.001),其中包膜平滑度和实质均匀性的改善最为显著。CD4+ T细胞比例和CD4+/CD8+比值增加,而CD8+ T细胞比例下降;NK细胞活性从42.7 ± 7.3%上升至52.4 ± 6.2%(P < 0.05)。超声评分与ALT(r = 0.56)和AST(r = 0.47)呈正相关,与CD4+/CD8+比值(r = −0.46)和NK细胞活性(r = −0.38)呈负相关(所有P < 0.01)。结论 这些发现表明,TAF不仅抑制病毒复制并使肝酶正常化,还促进可测量的肝脏结构改善,这体现在半定量超声评分的下降。超声评分与生化和免疫参数之间的强相关性支持其作为非侵入性影像生物标志物用于监测治疗疗效和肝脏修复的潜力。

papers.title: Detection method for carrying Hepatitis B surface antigen exosomes by a chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA)
papers.abstract: AIM: Conventional detection of Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) cannot differentiate exosome-associated antigen from its free form, which may hold distinct biological significance. Here, we developed a specific chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA) to detect HBsAg-positive, CD63-positive particles (putative HBsAg-carrying exosomes). METHODS: The assay employs magnetic beads coated with an anti-HBsAg antibody for exosome capture, followed by detection using an acridinium ester-labeled anti-CD63 antibody. All performance evaluations were conducted in normal human serum as the biological matrix. RESULTS: Analytical validation established cutoff value of 4,421 RLU from 80 blank replicates (per CLSI EP17-A2). The method demonstrated complete analytical agreement with the engineered reference samples tested (n = 15 negative; n = 5 positive). The limit of detection was 7.8 × 108 particles/mL, corresponding to a sample dilution factor of 128. Intra- and inter-assay precision yielded coefficients of variation below 15% across the measuring range. CONCLUSION: This CLIA provides an analytically validated qualitative screening tool for research use (classifying samples as positive or negative based on the established cutoff of 4,421 RLU) for the in vitro detection of HBsAg-positive, CD63-positive particles, facilitating future research into the role of exosomal cargo in Hepatitis B virus pathogenesis.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为建立了一种可靠的体外检测HBsAg阳性、CD63阳性颗粒的定性筛查工具,这可能有助于未来研究外泌体载物在乙型肝炎病毒 发病机制中的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果提供了一种区分与外泌体相关的HBsAg与其游离形式的方法,这可能对理解外泌体载物在乙型肝炎病毒感染和疾病进展中的生物学作用具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于在正常人血清中进行分析验证,证据强度中等,因为未包含临床或流行病学数据。

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:常规检测乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)无法区分与外泌体相关的抗原与其游离形式,这可能具有不同的生物学意义。在此,我们开发了一种特异性化学发光免疫分析法(CLIA)以检测HBsAg阳性、CD63阳性颗粒(推测为携带HBsAg的外泌体)。方法:该检测方法利用包被有抗-HBsAg抗体的磁珠捕获外泌体,随后使用吖啶酯标记的抗-CD63抗体进行检测。所有性能评估均在正常人血清中进行,作为生物基质。结果:分析验证确定了从80个空白重复样本中得出的截断值为4,421 RLU(根据CLSI EP17-A2标准)。该方法在测试的工程参考样本中表现出完全的分析一致性(n = 15阴性;n = 5阳性)。检测限为7.8 × 108颗粒/mL,对应于样本稀释因子为128。批内和批间精密度的变异系数在整个测量范围内均低于15%。结论:该CLIA提供了一种经过分析验证的定性筛查工具,适用于研究用途(根据建立的截断值4,421 RLU将样本分类为阳性或阴性),用于体外检测HBsAg阳性、CD63阳性颗粒,有助于未来研究外泌体载物在乙型肝炎病毒 发病机制中的作用。

papers.title: Prevalence of Decisional Regret and Associated Risk Factors in Patients With Hepatitis B Undergoing Pegylated Interferon Alpha Therapy.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Pegylated interferon alpha has been shown to enhance the likelihood of achieving a functional cure in patients with hepatitis B. However, it was associated with a greater number of contraindications and adverse reactions compared with nucleotide analogs. Current research has placed comparatively less emphasis on the potential for this treatment to induce decision regret among patients. AIM: The aim of this study was to investigate the current status of decision regret in hepatitis B patients undergoing interferon therapy and to explore its influencing factors. METHOD: A cross-sectional study was conducted in a comprehensive hospital in Xiamen, Fujian Province, China, from February 20 to June 13, 2024. The study recruited hepatitis B patients undergoing treatment with pegylated interferon alpha. The survey encompassed general information, the All Aspects of Health Literacy Scale, the Perceived Social Support Scale, the Control Preferences Scale, the Decisional Conflict Scale, and the Decision Regret Scale. RESULTS: A total of 130 questionnaires were analyzed. Only 13.85% of patients had no regrets at all about the decision, 34.60% experienced mild regret, and the proportion of patients with moderate to severe regrets reached 51.50%. Mild impact on life, active decision-making roles, passive decision-making roles, and decision conflict were the influencing factors of decisional regret in hepatitis B patients on pegylated interferon alpha therapy, which together explained 29.6% of the total variation. CONCLUSION: Hepatitis B patients undergoing pegylated interferon alpha therapy had a high percentage of decisional regret. Healthcare professionals should pay close attention to this phenomenon. In the future, they can investigate additional potential influencing factors and promptly develop intervention strategies to effectively reduce decision regret.

papers.title_zh: 接受聚乙二醇干扰素α治疗的乙型肝炎患者决策后悔及其相关危险因素研究
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Pegylated interferon alpha has been shown to enhance the likelihood of achieving a functional cure in patients with hepatitis B. However, it was associated with a greater number of contraindications and adverse reactions compared with nucleotide analogs. Current research has placed comparatively less emphasis on the potential for this treatment to induce decision regret among patients. AIM: The aim of this study was to investigate the current status of decision regret in hepatitis B patients undergoing interferon therapy and to explore its influencing factors. METHOD: A cross-sectional study was conducted in a comprehensive hospital in Xiamen, Fujian Province, China, from February 20 to June 13, 2024. The study recruited hepatitis B patients undergoing treatment with pegylated interferon alpha. The survey encompassed general information, the All Aspects of Health Literacy Scale, the Perceived Social Support Scale, the Control Preferences Scale, the Decisional Conflict Scale, and the Decision Regret Scale. RESULTS: A total of 130 questionnaires were analyzed. Only 13.85% of patients had no regrets at all about the decision, 34.60% experienced mild regret, and the proportion of patients with moderate to severe regrets reached 51.50%. Mild impact on life, active decision-making roles, passive decision-making roles, and decision conflict were the influencing factors of decisional regret in hepatitis B patients on pegylated interferon alpha therapy, which together explained 29.6% of the total variation. CONCLUSION: Hepatitis B patients undergoing pegylated interferon alpha therapy had a high percentage of decisional regret. Healthcare professionals should pay close attention to this phenomenon. In the future, they can investigate additional potential influencing factors and promptly develop intervention strategies to effectively reduce decision regret.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:聚乙二醇干扰素α已被证明可提高乙型肝炎患者实现功能性治愈的可能性。然而,与核苷类似物相比,其禁忌症和不良反应数量更多。目前的研究对这种治疗方式引发患者决策后悔的潜力关注较少。目的:本研究旨在探讨接受干扰素治疗的乙型肝炎患者当前的决策后悔状况,并探索其影响因素。方法:本研究于2024年2月20日至6月13日在中国福建省厦门市的一家综合医院进行横断面研究。研究纳入了接受聚乙二醇干扰素α治疗的乙型肝炎患者。调查内容包括一般信息、健康素养全方面量表、感知社会支持量表、控制偏好量表、决策冲突量表和决策后悔量表。结果:共分析了130份问卷。仅有13.85%的患者对决策完全没有后悔,34.60%的患者经历了轻微的后悔,而中度至重度后悔的患者比例达到了51.50%。对生活的影响程度较轻、主动决策角色、被动决策角色以及决策冲突是影响乙型肝炎患者接受聚乙二醇干扰素α治疗时决策后悔的因素,这些因素共同解释了总变异的29.6%。结论:接受聚乙二醇干扰素α治疗的乙型肝炎患者决策后悔的比例较高。医疗专业人员应对此现象给予高度重视。未来可以进一步研究其他潜在的影响因素,并及时制定干预策略以有效减少决策后悔。

papers.full_text: Abstract Background Hepatitis B virus infection among pregnant women is a significant public health problem in Ethiopia. Although primary studies on HBV infection among pregnant women have been conducted across different regions in Ethiopia, a synthesized pooled estimate and associated factors remain fragmented. Therefore, this systematic review was aimed at summarising the available information and making an accurate estimate of hepatitis B virus infection among pregnant women in Ethiopia. Methods A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted according to the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020. Different databases (Google Scholar, PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Scopus, Cochrane Library, and African Journal Online) were searched to identify relevant studies published between January 1, 2021, and December 25, 2025 in Ethiopia. The Joanna Briggs Institute tool was used to assess the methodological qualities of the included studies. The random effect DerSimonian-Liard model was used to estimate the pooled prevalence of Hepatitis B virus infection. I2 assessed the amount of heterogeneity. Publication bias was assessed using Egger’s test and a funnel plot. Results We included 25 studies conducted in Ethiopia. The pooled prevalence of hepatitis B infection among pregnant women in Ethiopia was 7.3% (95% CI: 6.3–8.4%), with significant heterogeneity between studies (I2 = 76.25%, p < 0.001). History of abortion(AOR = 3.81, 95%CI: 1.69–8.57), Body tattooing(AOR = 3.54, 95%CI: 1.65–7.58), Contact history with HBV patients(AOR = 8.38, 95%CI: 3.89,-18.06), HIV positivity(AOR = 10.04, 95%CI: 3.91–25.75), dental procedure(AOR = 3.64, 95%CI: 1.92, 6.92), Family history of HBV(AOR = 6.37, 95%CI: 3.83–10.6), History of blood transfusion(AOR = 6.32, 95%CI: 4.11–9.74), History of hospitalization(AOR = 3.99, 95%CI: 2.47–6.45), Multiple sexual partner(AOR = 7.91, 95%CI: 5.31–11.8) and Traditional tonsillectomy(AOR = 3.81, 95%CI: 1.92–7.57) were associated factors for hepatitis B infection among pregnant women. Conclusion A higher intermediate level of hepatitis B virus infection (2–7.99%) was observed among pregnant women in Ethiopia. Therefore, early detection of pregnant women, awareness creation on the mode of transmission of HBV, and early implementation of evidence-based control measures are recommended. analysis.scope_and_question: This review aimed to synthesise the available information and make an accurate estimate of hepatitis B virus infection among pregnant women in Ethiopia, with a focus on prevalence and associated factors.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted according to the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Studies were identified from multiple databases including Google Scholar, PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Scopus, Cochrane Library, and African Journal Online, covering publications from January 1, 2021, to December 25, 2025. The Joanna Briggs Institute tool was used to assess methodological quality, and the random effect DerSimonian-Liard model was applied to estimate pooled prevalence. Heterogeneity was assessed using I2, and publication bias was evaluated using Egger’s test and a funnel plot.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled prevalence of hepatitis B infection among pregnant women in Ethiopia was estimated at 7.3% (95% CI: 6.3–8.4%), with significant heterogeneity between studies (I2 = 76.25%, p < 0.001). Several factors were identified as being associated with HBV infection, including history of abortion, body tattooing, contact history with HBV patients, HIV positivity, dental procedures, family history of HBV, history of blood transfusion, history of hospitalization, multiple sexual partners, and traditional tonsillectomy.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that the available studies on HBV infection among pregnant women in Ethiopia are fragmented, and there is no consensus on the pooled estimate of prevalence. The significant heterogeneity (I2 = 76.25%) suggests variability in study designs and populations, which may affect the reliability of the pooled estimate. Additionally, the review notes that the evidence is limited in certain areas, such as the geographic distribution of risk factors and the impact of specific interventions.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Early detection of HBV infection in pregnant women, awareness creation on the mode of transmission, and the implementation of evidence-based control measures are recommended. Further research is needed to address the evidence gaps, particularly in understanding the mechanisms of transmission and the effectiveness of interventions in reducing HBV prevalence among pregnant women.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to estimate the prevalence of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection among pregnant women in Ethiopia and identify associated factors. A total of 25 studies published between 2021 and 2025 were included, and the pooled prevalence was found to be 7.3% (95% CI: 6.3–8.4%) with significant heterogeneity (I2 = 76.25%, p < 0.001). Several risk factors were identified, including history of abortion, body tattooing, contact with HBV patients, HIV positivity, dental procedures, family history of HBV, blood transfusion, hospitalization, multiple sexual partners, and traditional tonsillectomy. The review highlights the fragmented nature of the evidence and the need for more comprehensive studies to address the heterogeneity and gaps in understanding. It recommends early detection, awareness creation, and implementation of evidence-based control measures to manage HBV infection in pregnant women.

analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述指出,目前关于埃塞俄比亚孕妇乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染的研究是零散的,且对患病率的汇总估计值尚无共识。显著的异质性(I2 = 76.25%)表明研究设计和人群存在差异,这可能影响汇总估计值的可靠性。此外,综述还指出某些方面的证据有限,例如风险因素的地理分布以及特定干预措施的影响。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 建议早期检测孕妇中的HBV感染,提高对传播传播方式的认识,并实施基于证据的控制措施。需要进一步研究以解决证据缺口,特别是理解传播的机制以及干预措施在降低孕妇中HBV 患病率方面的有效性。

papers.title: The Emerging Role of China in the Innovation, Individualization, and Translation of Antiviral Therapeutics for Chronic Hepatitis B
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a major global health burden, and functional cure—sustained hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss, with or without antibody to HBsAg seroconversion, and undetectable hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA after treatment cessation—remains uncommon. China is moving from disease control toward therapeutic innovation and evidence generation. Bepirovirsen provides the first Phase III benchmark for finite therapy, but most biomarker‐selected patients did not achieve functional cure. China‐origin and China‐led programs are expanding across antigen‐lowering and immune‐modulating mechanisms, with both promising and negative results. This Perspective examines China's contribution to HBV drug development, individualized treatment, regulatory evaluation, real‐world translation, and endpoint refinement.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the role of China in the innovation, individualization, and translation of antiviral therapeutics for chronic hepatitis B (CHB). The central question is how China contributes to the development and application of HBV treatments, particularly in the context of functional cure, which involves sustained HBsAg loss, seroconversion, and undetectable HBV DNA after treatment cessation.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a Perspective article that examines China's contributions to HBV drug development, individualized treatment, regulatory evaluation, real-world translation, and endpoint refinement. analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies a lack of consensus on the definition and achievement of functional cure, as well as limited evidence on the long-term efficacy and safety of HBV treatments. analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on refining treatment endpoints, improving individualized treatment strategies, and enhancing real-world translation of HBV therapeutics. It also emphasizes the need for more robust evidence generation and regulatory evaluation to support the development of effective antiviral therapies for chronic hepatitis B.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores China's evolving role in the development and application of antiviral therapeutics for chronic hepatitis B (CHB). The review underscores China's shift from disease control to therapeutic innovation, with expanding programs in antigen-lowering and immune-modulating mechanisms. However, it also identifies gaps in evidence and consensus, emphasizing the need for further research and improved real-world translation of HBV treatments.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于中国在抗病毒药物治疗药物创新、个体化和翻译中的作用。核心问题是:中国如何在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)的HBV 治疗治疗药物开发和应用中发挥作用,特别是在涉及持续HBsAg丢失、血清转换以及停止治疗治疗后HBV DNA不可检测的功能性治愈背景下。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是一篇观点文章,探讨了中国在HBV药物开发、个体化治疗治疗、监管评估、真实世界转化以及终点优化方面的贡献。它并未报告特定数据库、检索日期或研究纳入标准,也未包含对研究结果的荟萃分析或综合估计。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述指出,bepirovirsen为有限疗程治疗提供了首个III期试验基准,但大多数基于生物标志物选择的患者未能实现功能性治愈。同时,综述还提到中国正在从疾病控制向治疗药物创新和证据生成转变,相关项目正在扩展至抗原降低和免疫调节机制,结果既有积极的也有消极的。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,对于功能性治愈的定义和实现标准尚无共识,且关于HBV 治疗的长期疗效和安全性证据有限。此外,尽管中国主导的项目正在扩展,但这些项目的证据基础仍不完整,需要进一步研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议未来研究应聚焦于优化治疗的终点指标、改进个体化治疗治疗策略,并加强HBV治疗药物在真实世界中的转化应用。同时,强调需要更坚实的证据生成和监管评估,以支持针对慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)的有效抗病毒药物治疗药物的开发。

papers.title: ORC1 expression features and its prognostic significance in HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma
papers.abstract: Objective Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a leading cause of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Conventional biomarkers alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and des-gamma-carboxy prothrombin (DCP) have diagnostic limitations, particularly for early-stage disease. This study investigated the expression profile of ORC1 in HBV-related liver disease and its association with HBV infection, disease progression, and prognosis. Methods 178 participants were recruited: 124 HBV-positive cases (49 HBV-HCC, 33 HBV-cirrhosis, 42 chronic hepatitis B) and 54 HBV-negative controls (35 non-HBV-HCC, 19 hepatic hemangioma). Tissue ORC1 was detected by immunohistochemistry, and serum ORC1 was measured by ELISA in a subset of 17 HBV-HCC patients with available serum. Logistic regression identified factors associated with high ORC1 expression. ROC curves were used to evaluate the discrimination of tissue ORC1, AFP, and DCP for HBV-HCC, and the correlation between ORC1 and tumor diameter was analyzed. TCGA-LIHC data were used for external validation. Results Tissue ORC1 was significantly upregulated in HBV-positive patients, and HBV infection was independently associated with high ORC1 expression (P 0. High ORC1 expression was associated with poorer overall survival in TCGA-LIHC (HR = 1. Conclusion ORC1 upregulation is independently associated with HBV infection and increases with disease progression in HBV-related liver disease. Although tissue ORC1 showed only moderate discrimination for HBV-HCC, high ORC1 expression was associated with poorer overall survival in TCGA-LIHC. These findings suggest that ORC1 is primarily a proliferation- and progression-related marker in HBV-related liver disease.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to investigate the expression profile of ORC1 in HBV-related liver disease and its association with HBV infection, disease progression, and prognosis. The research included 178 participants, comprising 124 HBV-positive cases and 54 HBV-negative controls. ORC1 expression was assessed using immunohistochemistry and ELISA, with logistic regression and ROC curves used to analyze its association with HBV infection and tumor characteristics. Results showed that tissue ORC1 was significantly upregulated in HBV-positive patients, and high ORC1 expression was linked to poorer overall survival in TCGA-LIHC data. The authors interpreted these findings as indicating that ORC1 is a proliferation- and progression-related marker in HBV-related liver disease. The study's implications suggest potential use of ORC1 as a biomarker for early detection and prognosis of HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma. However, the evidence is limited by the moderate discrimination of tissue ORC1 for HBV-HCC and the reliance on external validation data.

papers.title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver and antiviral response in chronic hepatitis B: A systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) frequently coexists with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, its association with antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB remains unclear. AIM To systematically evaluate the impact of MAFLD on antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB. METHODS This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. PubMed, the Cochrane Library, EMBASE, and Web of Science were searched for studies published up to November 30, 2025. Meta-analyses were performed to assess associations between MAFLD and antiviral treatment responses or clinical outcomes. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach, and leave-one-out sensitivity analyses were performed to evaluate robustness. RESULTS Thirty-two studies were included, of which 20 evaluated antiviral treatment efficacy and 13 assessed clinical outcomes in patients with CHB and concomitant MAFLD (one study reported both treatment responses and clinical outcomes). MAFLD was associated with a higher rate of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at 48 weeks [odds ratio (OR) = 1.41, 95%CI: 1.28-1.55], although this association was attenuated at 96 weeks (OR = 1.44, 95%CI: 0.96-2.16). No significant association was observed between MAFLD and hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance at any time-point. MAFLD was consistently associated with lower rates of alanine aminotransferase normalization and hepatitis B virus DNA clearance throughout the treatment duration. MAFLD was associated with a significantly increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) despite antiviral therapy (OR = 1.50, 95%CI: 1.01-2.24). Subgroup analyses according to the antiviral regimen revealed distinct patterns, partly explaining the heterogeneity in the overall analyses. Subgroup analyses suggested that the antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach partly explained the heterogeneity, particularly for hepatitis B virus DNA clearance and HCC. CONCLUSION MAFLD was associated with lower virological and biochemical response rates, higher odds of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at week 48, particularly among patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy, and higher odds of HCC in patients with CHB, but not with hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance. These findings support metabolic risk assessment in CHB management and highlight the need for standardized MAFLD/metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease definitions.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述旨在评估 MAFLD 对 抗病毒药物 治疗 反应和 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者长期临床结果的影响。核心问题是 MAFLD 是否影响 CHB 患者对 抗病毒药物 治疗的病毒学、生化和临床反应。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本次系统评价和荟萃分析遵循 PRISMA 指南。证据基础包括来自 PubMed、Cochrane 图书馆、EMBASE 和 Web of Science 的截至 2025 年 11 月 30 日发表的研究。基于 抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法进行亚组分析,并进行留一敏感性分析以评估研究结果的稳健性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MAFLD 与较低的病毒学和生化反应率、第 48 周时乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除的几率较高(特别是在接受核苷(酸)类似物治疗的患者中)以及尽管接受 抗病毒药物 治疗但发生肝细胞癌(HCC)的几率增加有关。然而,在任何时间点均未观察到 MAFLD 与乙型肝炎 e 抗原血清清除之间存在显着关联。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 亚组分析表明,抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法部分解释了总体结果的异质性,特别是 乙型肝炎病毒 DNA 清除率和 HCC 方面。证据没有报告 MAFLD 与这些结果相关的具体机制,也没有报告 MAFLD 对其他临床结果(如肝纤维化进展)的影响。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持将代谢风险评估纳入慢性乙型肝炎的管理,并强调需要对 MAFLD 和代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病进行标准化定义。

analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MAFLD 与较低的病毒学和生化反应率、第 48 周时乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除的几率较高(特别是在接受核苷(酸)类似物治疗的患者中)以及尽管接受 抗病毒药物 治疗但发生肝细胞癌(HCC)的几率增加有关。然而,在任何时间点均未观察到 MAFLD 与乙型肝炎 e 抗原血清清除之间存在显着关联。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 亚组分析表明,抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法部分解释了总体结果的异质性,特别是 乙型肝炎病毒 DNA 清除率和 HCC 方面。证据没有报告 MAFLD 与这些结果相关的具体机制,也没有报告 MAFLD 对其他临床结果(如肝纤维化进展)的影响。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持将代谢风险评估纳入慢性乙型肝炎的管理,并强调需要对 MAFLD 和代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病进行标准化定义。

papers.title: National Health Insurance Expenditure and Health-System Use for Hepatitis B and C in Bulgaria, 2021–2025
papers.abstract: Background: National reimbursement records complement model-based estimates of hepatitis treatment costs. Our primary objective was to quantify Bulgarian National Health Insurance Fund (NHIF) antiviral reimbursement and its price and quantity components; secondary objectives were to estimate dispensing-based treatment volume and describe service activity. Methods: This retrospective study analysed aggregated national pharmacy records for complete years 2021–2025 and hospital and outpatient records for complete years 2024–2025. Diagnosis-identified records were combined with product-identified antiviral prescriptions under fibrosis or cirrhosis codes. Fisher indices decomposed expenditure; seasonal quasi-Poisson models with Newey–West standard errors described monthly trends. Results: Antiviral reimbursement totalled EUR 101.5 million, including EUR 91.6 million for HCV and EUR 10.0 million for HBV. Annual antiviral reimbursement increased from EUR 18.9 million to EUR 21.7 million. The budget share for all pharmacy products in the hepatitis case definition, including adjunctive products, declined from 3.99% to 2.61%. Relative to 2021, the 2025 Fisher price and quantity indices were 0.799 and 1.395 for HBV and 0.885 and 1.447 for HCV. Estimated mean continuous HBV therapy increased from 2226 to 3051 people; HCV standard-course equivalents increased from 604 to 777, with duration-based ranges of 431–607 and 571–777. These estimates do not identify unique treated patients. Annualised inpatient-episode trends during 2024–2025 were 9.2% for HBV and −7.4% for HCV; consultation trends were 3.7% and −6.9%. Conclusions: Dispensed treatment volume increased while reimbursed unit prices and the hepatitis pharmaceutical budget share declined. These findings describe payer expenditure and encounters; they do not establish improved affordability, access, or treatment coverage.

It uses aggregated pharmacy and hospital records to estimate expenditure trends and decompose costs using Fisher indices and seasonal quasi-Poisson models. The results show an increase in treatment volume but a decline in reimbursed unit prices and pharmaceutical budget share. These findings provide insights into the economic burden of hepatitis treatment and highlight the need for monitoring cost trends to inform healthcare policy. However, the study has limitations, including the inability to identify unique treated patients and the lack of detailed analysis on potential biases or confounding factors, which moderate the confidence in the results.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为保加利亚乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎 治疗 的医疗保健政策和预算规划提供信息。他们强调需要监控 治疗 数量和成本趋势,以确保有效的资源分配。

papers.title: Associations of HBV DNA Level with Liver-Related Parameters and Non-Invasive Liver Scores in Hepatitis B Virus Infection: A Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study in Saudi Arabia
papers.abstract: Background and Objectives: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major cause of progressive liver disease worldwide. Although HBV DNA reflects viral replication, its relationships with conventional liver biochemical markers and non-invasive indices remain insufficiently studied in Saudi patients. This study evaluated the associations of HBV DNA level with conventional liver-related parameters, the Albumin–Bilirubin (ALBI) score, and the Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) index. Materials and Methods: This retrospective cross-sectional study included patients with HBV infection evaluated at King Khalid University Hospital between January 2015 and June 2026. Laboratory data collected within 12 months of the recorded diagnosis date were used to calculate ALBI and FIB-4 scores. Relationships between HBV DNA and liver-related parameters were evaluated using Spearman correlation and group comparisons based on a predefined threshold of 2000 IU/mL. Multivariable logistic regression assessed factors associated with ALBI Grades 2–3. Results: Among 394 patients, median liver enzyme levels were generally within their reference ranges, although 55.7% of patients with available data had ALBI Grades 2–3. Among 160 patients with quantifiable HBV DNA, viral load correlated significantly with all seven evaluated liver-related parameters in the full analytical cohort, with AST showing the strongest association (ρ = 0.437, p < 0.001), although sensitivity analyses suggested these associations may partly reflect treatment-related differences in viral load distribution. Patients with HBV DNA ≥2000 IU/mL had significantly different liver-related parameters than those below this threshold. Each tenfold increase in HBV DNA was associated with 69% higher odds of ALBI Grades 2–3 (OR = 1.69; 95% CI: 1.32–2.25; p < 0.001). ALBI and FIB-4 were moderately positively correlated (ρ = 0.392, p < 0.001). Conclusions: Higher HBV DNA levels were associated with differences in liver-related parameters and poorer ALBI grade. Combining viral-load measurement with conventional markers and non-invasive indices may provide a more comprehensive assessment of hepatic involvement in HBV infection.

papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 感染中 HBV DNA 水平与肝脏相关参数和非侵入性肝脏评分的关联:沙特阿拉伯的一项回顾性横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: Background and Objectives: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major cause of progressive liver disease worldwide. Although HBV DNA reflects viral replication, its relationships with conventional liver biochemical markers and non-invasive indices remain insufficiently studied in Saudi patients. This study evaluated the associations of HBV DNA level with conventional liver-related parameters, the Albumin–Bilirubin (ALBI) score, and the Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) index. Materials and Methods: This retrospective cross-sectional study included patients with HBV infection evaluated at King Khalid University Hospital between January 2015 and June 2026. Laboratory data collected within 12 months of the recorded diagnosis date were used to calculate ALBI and FIB-4 scores. Relationships between HBV DNA and liver-related parameters were evaluated using Spearman correlation and group comparisons based on a predefined threshold of 2000 IU/mL. Multivariable logistic regression assessed factors associated with ALBI Grades 2–3. Results: Among 394 patients, median liver enzyme levels were generally within their reference ranges, although 55.7% of patients with available data had ALBI Grades 2–3. Among 160 patients with quantifiable HBV DNA, viral load correlated significantly with all seven evaluated liver-related parameters in the full analytical cohort, with AST showing the strongest association (ρ = 0.437, p < 0.001), although sensitivity analyses suggested these associations may partly reflect treatment-related differences in viral load distribution. Patients with HBV DNA ≥2000 IU/mL had significantly different liver-related parameters than those below this threshold. Each tenfold increase in HBV DNA was associated with 69% higher odds of ALBI Grades 2–3 (OR = 1.69; 95% CI: 1.32–2.25; p < 0.001). ALBI and FIB-4 were moderately positively correlated (ρ = 0.392, p < 0.001). Conclusions: Higher HBV DNA levels were associated with differences in liver-related parameters and poorer ALBI grade. Combining viral-load measurement with conventional markers and non-invasive indices may provide a more comprehensive assessment of hepatic involvement in HBV infection.

papers.title: Association Between Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Positivity and Tumor Incidence: A Large Prospective Cohort Study in Southern China
papers.abstract: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a major global health concern and has been implicated in carcinogenesis. However, evidence regarding the association between hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positivity and the risk of overall and site-specific tumors remains limited. This study aimed to investigate the association between HBsAg positivity and tumor incidence in a large prospective cohort. Methods: This prospective cohort study included 538,573 participants recruited in southern China between 2009 and 2015. Newly recorded tumor diagnoses were identified by linkage to a hospital discharge database available through December 2022. Missing covariate values were addressed using five multiple imputations, and propensity score matching was performed separately within each dataset. Cox model estimates were combined using Rubin’s rules. Time-varying and landmark analyses were also performed. Results: Baseline HBsAg positivity was associated with increased risks of all-site tumors (pooled hazard ratio [HR], 2.02; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.79–2.27), digestive system malignancies (pooled HR, 4.28; 95% CI, 3.51–5.22), and benign tumors (pooled HR, 1.52; 95% CI, 1.27–1.82). Strong associations were observed for liver and intrahepatic bile duct malignancies (pooled HR, 15.49; 95% CI, 8.99–26.67) and hepatocellular carcinoma (pooled HR, 19.78; 95% CI, 7.19–54.44). In contrast, the association with extrahepatic digestive system malignancies was not statistically significant. The associations generally attenuated over follow-up but persisted after excluding tumor events recorded within the first 1 and 2 years. Stronger associations with all-site tumors were observed among men and participants aged ≥45 years. Conclusions: Baseline HBsAg positivity was associated with an increased risk of overall and site-specific tumors, particularly digestive system malignancies. The associations were stronger among men and older adults. These findings support further clinical evaluation of HBsAg-positive individuals and guideline-based liver cancer surveillance when clinically indicated.

source_records.abstract: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a major global health concern and has been implicated in carcinogenesis. However, evidence regarding the association between hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positivity and the risk of overall and site-specific tumors remains limited. This study aimed to investigate the association between HBsAg positivity and tumor incidence in a large prospective cohort. Methods: This prospective cohort study included 538,573 participants recruited in southern China between 2009 and 2015. Newly recorded tumor diagnoses were identified by linkage to a hospital discharge database available through December 2022. Missing covariate values were addressed using five multiple imputations, and propensity score matching was performed separately within each dataset. Cox model estimates were combined using Rubin’s rules. Time-varying and landmark analyses were also performed. papers.abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染是全球主要的健康问题,并与致癌作用有关。然而,关于乙肝表面抗原(HBsAg)阳性与总体和特定部位肿瘤风险之间关联的证据仍然有限。本研究旨在探讨HBsAg阳性与肿瘤风险在一项大型前瞻性队列研究中的关联。方法:这项前瞻性队列研究包括2009年至2015年间在中国南方招募的538,573名参与者。通过与医院出院数据库链接,识别出新记录的肿瘤诊断,该数据库可追溯至2022年12月。缺失的协变量值采用五次多重插补方法处理,并在每个数据集中分别进行倾向评分匹配。Cox模型估计值采用Rubin规则进行合并。同时进行了时间变化分析和地标分析。结果:基线HBsAg阳性与所有部位肿瘤风险增加相关(合并风险比[HR]为2.02;95%置信区间[CI]为1.79–2.27),消化系统恶性肿瘤(合并HR为4.28;95% CI为3.51–5.22)以及良性肿瘤(合并HR为1.52;95% CI为1.27–1.82)相关。肝癌和肝内胆管恶性肿瘤表现出强烈的关联(合并HR为15.49;95% CI为8.99–26.67),以及肝细胞癌(合并HR为19.78;95% CI为7.19–54.44)相关。相比之下,与消化系统恶性肿瘤(非肝部)的关联没有统计学意义。这些关联通常在随访过程中减弱,但在排除前1年和2年内记录的肿瘤事件后仍持续存在。所有部位肿瘤的关联在男性和年龄≥45岁的参与者中更为显著。结论:基线HBsAg阳性与总体和特定部位肿瘤风险增加相关,尤其是消化系统恶性肿瘤。这些关联在男性和老年人中更为明显。这些发现支持对HBsAg阳性个体进行进一步的临床评估,并在临床需要时依据指南进行肝癌监测。

papers.title: DISTRIBUTION OF FIVE HEPATITIS B VIRUS MARKERS IN HIV INFECTED AND UNINFECTED INJECTING DRUG USERS IN COASTAL KENYA
papers.abstract: Aims: This study determined HBV sero-markers profile in HIV-1 infected (n=157) and uninfected (n=214) IDUs from Mombasa, Kenya HIV-1 diagnosis was performed using DetermineTM and UnigoldTM rapid tests. Methodology: The CD4+ T cells were enumerated using the FacsCalibur flow cytometer and categorized according to the Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) immunological staging criteria. HBV seroprofile was determined using HBV-5 panel rapid test cassettes. Clinical staging was based on serological profile of the five HBV markers. Results: HBsAg (P=0.004) and HBcAb-IgM (P=0.008) positivities were higher in the HIV-1 infected compared to the uninfected individuals while the opposite was observed for HBsAb positivity (P=0.019). Rates of acute (P=0.033) and chronic (P=0.021) clinical stages were higher in the HIV-1 infected compared to the uninfected individuals but the inverse was noticed for vaccine type response rate (P=0.008). Only genotype A, sub-genotype A1 was detected with higher frequencies noted in the HIV-1 infected (n=12) compared to the uninfected (n=4) individuals. Conclusion: HBsAg and HBcAb-IgM sero-markers and acute and chronic clinical categories are higher while HBsAb sero-marker and vaccine type response stage are lower in HIV-1 infected compared to uninfected IDUs at Mombasa, Kenya. Taken together, HIV infected injection drug users are at risk of acquiring HBV and progressing to chronic infection.
papers.journal: Global Journal of Research in Medicine and Dentistry

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to determine the distribution of five hepatitis B virus (HBV) markers in HIV-1 infected and uninfected injecting drug users (IDUs) in Mombasa, Kenya, to understand the relationship between HIV and HBV infections in this population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 157 HIV-1 infected and 214 uninfected injecting drug users in Mombasa, Kenya, between 2023 and 2024. HIV-1 diagnosis was performed using DetermineTM and UnigoldTM rapid tests.
analysis.methods: HBV seroprofile was determined using HBV-5 panel rapid test cassettes. CD4+ T cells were enumerated using the FacsCalibur flow cytometer and categorized according to CDC immunological staging criteria. Clinical staging was based on the serological profile of the five HBV markers.
analysis.main_results: HBsAg (P=0.004) and HBcAb-IgM (P=0.008) positivities were higher in HIV-1 infected compared to uninfected individuals, while HBsAb positivity was lower (P=0.019). Rates of acute (P=0.033) and chronic (P=0.021) clinical stages were higher in HIV-1 infected individuals, but vaccine type response rate was lower (P=0.008). Only genotype A, sub-genotype A1 was detected, with higher frequencies in HIV-1 infected individuals (n=12) compared to uninfected (n=4).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that HIV-1 infection is associated with increased risk of HBV acquisition and progression to chronic infection, while vaccine response is diminished in this group.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the importance of monitoring HBV markers in HIV-1 infected injecting drug users to inform targeted prevention and treatment strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and reliance on rapid tests, which may have lower sensitivity. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational nature of the study.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the distribution of five hepatitis B virus (HBV) markers in HIV-1 infected and uninfected injecting drug users (IDUs) in Mombasa, Kenya. It found that HBsAg and HBcAb-IgM were more prevalent in HIV-1 infected individuals, while HBsAb positivity was lower. Acute and chronic HBV clinical stages were also more common in HIV-1 infected IDUs, but vaccine response rates were reduced. Only HBV genotype A1 was detected, with higher frequencies in HIV-1 infected individuals. The study suggests that HIV-1 infection may increase the risk of HBV acquisition and progression to chronic infection, emphasizing the need for targeted surveillance and interventions in this population. The evidence is moderate due to the cross-sectional design and use of rapid tests.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在确定肯尼亚蒙巴萨 HIV-1 感染者和未感染注射吸毒者 (IDU) 中 5 个 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 标记物的分布,以了解该人群中 HIV 和 HBV 感染之间的关系。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023 年至 2024 年间,在肯尼亚蒙巴萨对 157 名 HIV-1 感染者和 214 名未感染的注射吸毒者进行了一项横断面研究。使用 DefineTM 和 UnigoldTM 快速检测进行 HIV-1 诊断。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 HBV-5 组快速检测盒测定 HBV 血清谱。使用 FacsCalibur 流式细胞仪对 CD4+ T 细胞进行计数,并根据 CDC 免疫分期标准进行分类。临床分期基于五种 HBV 标志物的血清学特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 与未感染者相比,HIV-1 感染者的 HBsAg (P=0.004) 和 HBcAb-IgM (P=0.008) 阳性率较高,而 HBsAb 阳性率较低 (P=0.019)。HIV-1感染者的急性(P=0.033)和慢性(P=0.021)临床分期率较高,但疫苗型缓解率较低(P=0.008)。仅检测到基因型 A、亚基因型 A1,与未感染者 (n=4) 相比,HIV-1 感染者 (n=12) 中出现频率较高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,HIV-1 感染与 HBV 感染和进展为慢性感染的风险增加有关,而该组中的 疫苗 反应减弱。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果强调了监测 HIV-1 感染的注射吸毒者的 HBV 标志物的重要性,以指导有针对性的预防和 治疗 策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其横断面设计和对快速测试的依赖而受到限制,而快速测试的敏感性可能较低。由于该研究的观察性质,证据的强度中等。

analysis_zh.methods: 使用 HBV-5 组快速检测盒测定 HBV 血清谱。使用 FacsCalibur 流式细胞仪对 CD4+ T 细胞进行计数,并根据 CDC 免疫分期标准进行分类。临床分期基于五种 HBV 标志物的血清学特征。
analysis_zh.main_results: 与未感染者相比,HIV-1 感染者的 HBsAg (P=0.004) 和 HBcAb-IgM (P=0.008) 阳性率较高,而 HBsAb 阳性率较低 (P=0.019)。HIV-1感染者的急性(P=0.033)和慢性(P=0.021)临床分期率较高,但疫苗型缓解率较低(P=0.008)。仅检测到基因型 A、亚基因型 A1,与未感染者 (n=4) 相比,HIV-1 感染者 (n=12) 中出现频率较高。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,HIV-1 感染与 HBV 感染和进展为慢性感染的风险增加有关,而该组中的 疫苗 反应减弱。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果强调了监测 HIV-1 感染的注射吸毒者的 HBV 标志物的重要性,以指导有针对性的预防和 治疗 策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其横断面设计和对快速测试的依赖而受到限制,而快速测试的敏感性可能较低。由于该研究的观察性质,证据的强度中等。
